title: MaximeRivest/riddle
claim: MaximeRivest/riddle — The diary of Tom Riddle for the reMarkable Paper Pro — write with your pen, the page drinks your ink and answers in a fl
why_good: Turns the reMarkable e-ink tablet into a 'magic diary' that writes back — a delightful, novel AI-on-paper interaction.
value: Niche prosumer add-on for reMarkable owners; hard to charge much, but a charming wedge into AI-augmented paper.
risk: Tiny hardware niche (reMarkable), dependent on their platform; a whimsical demo more than a scalable business.

zh.claim: MaximeRivest/riddle —— reMarkable Paper Pro 上的 汤姆·里德尔的日记:用笔写,书页会回应。
zh.why_good: 把 reMarkable 墨水屏变成会回话的 魔法日记——一个讨喜、新颖的 AI 在纸上 交互。
zh.value: 给 reMarkable 用户的小众专业插件;很难收多少钱,但是切入 AI 增强纸张 的迷人切口。
zh.risk: 极小的硬件细分(reMarkable)、依赖其平台;更像奇思演示而非可规模化生意。
zh.gap: 在电子墨水上手写、纸面回你话，这个能力是真的、也确实好玩，但它被锁在一小块硬件上。缺口在于：没人把同一个回路做到普通人手上已有的纸本和平板上。
zh.counter: 只在 reMarkable 上活的插件，命完全握在一家厂商手里，受众体量近似误差项。很好的 demo，不清楚的生意。

gap: Handwriting on e-ink that answers back is a real and charming capability, but it is locked to one small piece of hardware. The gap is that nobody has built the same loop on the paper notebooks and tablets ordinary people already own.
counter: A reMarkable-only add-on lives entirely at the mercy of one vendor's platform, and the audience is a rounding error. Delightful demo, unclear business.
consumer_angle: Somebody who journals on paper; the deliverable is a written reply on the page. Real, but the platform is tiny.
